aboutMeDesc: I am a 2nd-year B.Tech student in Information Science and Engineering at N.M.A.M Institute of Technology, Nitte. Passionate about web development, 3D visuals, and interactive UI design. Skilled in C, Python, HTML, CSS, and React; I enjoy building websites and experimenting with AI-powered tools and creative prompts.
